Name: Seahawk Cross Country Invitational
Location: Hilton Head High School, Hilton Head Island, SC
Notes: NewsBank result lists team standings for the 3.1-mile invitational. No St. Andrew's individual runners were printed.
RecapParagraphs: St. Andrew's placed 8th in the boys team standings with 219 points.
Summerville won the boys race with 32 points, followed by Hilton Head, Stratford, Windsor Forest, Jenkins, Walterboro, and Battery Creek before St. Andrew's.
The girls team standings did not include St. Andrew's.
SourceCitation: "SEAHAWK CROSS COUNTRY INVITATIONAL," Savannah Morning News, 1999-09-05, Page 4C

Name: Augusta Prep Mile Relay
Notes: Archive recap supplied for the Augusta Prep mile relay. Relay times are indexed for each listed St. Andrew's runner.
RecapParagraphs: At Augusta Prep, St. Andrew's entered three boys' mile relay teams and one girls' mile relay team.

The boys' A team of Ben Harrison, Ryan Kirby, and Jon Moser placed 5th in 18:42. The boys' B team of Alex Chu, Scott Mullen, and Josh Taylor placed 11th in 20:10, and the boys' C team of Remy Thurston, Justin Hur, and Joe Nodzak placed 12th in 20:54.
The girls' team of Jessica Topolewski, Stephanie Griffin, and Michelle Griffin placed 11th in 24:00.

Name: St. George 3.1 Mile
Notes: Archive recap supplied for the 3.1-mile meet at St. George, South Carolina.
RecapParagraphs: St. Andrew's won the boys' team race with 49 points, ahead of Thomas Sumter, Orangeburg Prep, and The King's Academy.
Ben Harrison led the Lions boys with a winning 19:14. Jon Moser placed 8th in 21:56, Bryan Kirby placed 12th in 22:41, Justin Hur placed 13th in 23:12, and Josh Taylor placed 15th in 23:28.

Thomas Sumter won the girls' team race with 28 points. St. Andrew's did not have enough girls runners to place as a team, but Jessica Topolewski placed 5th in 26:10, Michelle Griffin placed 13th in 28:23, and Lily Adams placed 14th in 28:25.

TeamResults.Note: Did not have enough runners to place as a team.

Name: Augusta Prep Cross Country
Notes: Archive recap supplied for the September 7 cross country meet at Augusta Prep.
RecapParagraphs: St. Andrew's finished 4th in the boys team standings with 102 points in a seven-team meet won by Aiken.
Ben Harrison led the boys by placing 9th in 20:33. Jon Moser placed 25th in 23:04, Ryan Kirby placed 33rd in 23:36, Alex Lucas ran 23:47, and Justin Hur placed 42nd in 24:01.

The St. Andrew's girls finished 5th with 142 points in a seven-team meet won by Aiken. Jessica Topolewski won the girls race in 26:36, followed by Michelle Griffin, Lily Adams, Stephanie Griffin, and Lizzie Verner for St. Andrew's.

Name: Hilton Head Prep 3.1 Mile
Location: Hilton Head Prep, Hilton Head Island, SC
Notes: Archive recap supplied for the 3.1-mile meet at Hilton Head Prep.
RecapParagraphs: St. Andrew's finished 3rd in both team races at Hilton Head Prep. The boys scored 77 points behind Bluffton and Hilton Head Prep, while the girls scored 88 points behind Hilton Head Prep and Hilton Head High.
Ben Harrison placed 2nd in the boys race in 19:37. Jon Moser ran 21:00, Alex Lucas ran 22:00, Ryan Kirby ran 22:18, and Scott Mullen ran 23:23.
Jessica Topolewski led the St. Andrew's girls in 26:17, followed by Michelle Griffin in 26:59, Stephanie Griffin in 27:01, Lily Adams in 28:26, and Lizzie Verner in 31:37.
